bio.text: Patty Murray is a U.S. Senator from Washington, first elected in 1992 and re-elected in 1998, 2004, 2010, 2016 and 2022.

She was born and raised in Bothell, Washington, attended Washington State University, and taught at Shoreline Community College before serving on the Shoreline School Board and being elected to the Washington State Senate in 1988.
